name: How do I know if my window sill needs replacement?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my window sill needs replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs that your window sill needs replacement include visible soft spots when poked with a screwdriver, discoloration, crumbling wood, or cracks. You might also notice a musty odor, peeling paint, or a spongy texture. If the rot is extensive, it can compromise the window's seal and allow water intrusion into your home, potentially leading to further damage and drafts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for soft spots, discoloration, crumbling wood, cracks, or a musty odor. Extensive rot can compromise the window seal.
